# Driving School CMS

> PHP CMS for driving schools / trafikkskoler. Live demo: https://bilohash.com/driving-school/cms/
> Product: https://bilohash.com/driving-school/
> Admin demo: demo / demo

## Stack
- PHP 8, JSON storage, multilingual NO/EN/UK/RU
- Schema.org DrivingSchool, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList
- NOK prices, Oslo demo branding (fictional)

## Cron
- /driving-school/cms/cron/cleanup.php
- /driving-school/cms/cron/seed-demo.php
